PDPL (Phantom Dust Plugin Loader) 1.2.2 by Torphedo: https://github.com/Torphedo/pd_loader_core
pd_loader_core.dll from the release's pdpl.zip as REPLACED on 2026-11-23 (same tag 1.2.2; pdpl.zip sha256 dcae2a81353a71dabddfa392bdb17452bd12c11f85c54e1c87e051712fa43bef, uploaded by Torphedo). A MinGW build that exports its functions; the source on trunk is still commit 4264ea4. The 1.2.2 of 2025-12-24 (MSVC, no exports) was 5e6b7f2f9430322c6f3dbe838009ca622f248edf9c6dd09491a5edf1023be4ae.
pdlaunch injects it into the game while the game is still suspended; it loads mod files from RoamingState\mods.
pdnet uses its exports PHYSFS_* and open_mutex to swap the mounted archives while the game runs (src\pdpl.cpp).
To update PDPL: replace the DLL and the sha256 line below (build.ps1 refuses a DLL that doesn't match it).
sha256 pd_loader_core.dll c5f8ea75472c4e4263792dc35d6507f71bbcff708368b6d32fdc03edff1d52c9
